instruction: A candid documentary photograph with a shallow depth of field, captured in a full shot at eye-level. On an outdoor wooden boardwalk with a metal railing, two women are playfully interacting. On the left, the woman in the beige hoodie (R1) steps forward in grey leggings and pink sneakers, holding hands with the woman in the grey hijab (R3) on the right, who wears a pink jacket, white pants, and pink sneakers. Both women are looking down at their feet, smiling as they dance together. Soft, natural daylight with a warm tone highlights their expressions, while the edges of the frame are softly blurred.
elements: R1 is the forward-stepping hand-holding dance partner
R3 is the grey-hijab partner holding hands with R1
R1 and R3 dance together while connected by their hands
R1 and R3 look down toward their feet while smiling
The interaction takes place on an outdoor wooden boardwalk with a metal railing
